settings.title: Turn-by-turn on the cluster and HUD
CarPlay turns in the car's own format (AR HUD arrow)
settings.description: Within about 450 m of a maneuver, CarPlay's turn goes to the cluster and HUD as the car's own navigation sends it: turn, U-turn, fork, exit and roundabout types with their angle and a distance bar, which the AR HUD animates. Farther away, and in the HUD's turn list, the icons as before. Checked on this car (EV6 KR, 260902) with right, left, slight left and U-turns; forks, highway exits and roundabouts not yet. Turn it off if a turn looks wrong on the cluster or HUD. Takes effect when the head unit restarts.

settings.title: Wireless CarPlay (Bluetooth bridge and Wi-Fi sessions)
CarPlay music and Siri over Wi-Fi (AAC, Opus)
Song info on wireless CarPlay (cluster, media widget)
settings.description: DiPO only asks the iPhone for song info on USB; the mod asks on wireless too. A hook in DiPO (no files changed).

settings.title: CarPlay starts as soon as Bluetooth is ready
settings.description: The CarPlay app starts when Bluetooth is ready (about 30-40 s after power-on) instead of at the end of startup (about 47 s), so the phone connects up to 10 s sooner.

settings.title: USB drives and hubs don't start wired Android Auto
settings.description: A hook in the Android Auto app (no files changed). Without it, a USB drive can block wireless Android Auto until the head unit restarts.

settings.title: Artist and title in the cluster's CarPlay song popup
settings.description: The car's cluster service sends the CarPlay song title alone to the cluster (the artist only to the HUD). This sends "artist - title" instead (up to 63 characters). A hook in system_server (no files changed).

settings.title: Call state from the iPhone on wireless CarPlay
settings.description: DiPO asks the iPhone for its call state only on USB, so on wireless the steering wheel's call button didn't know about calls (a press during a call put it on hold). The mod asks on wireless too, so the button answers, ends and rejects calls as on USB.

settings.title: Call button opens CarPlay Phone when there's no call
settings.description: A short press of the steering wheel's call button with no call opens the Phone app in CarPlay. Needs the call state setting. During a call the button answers or ends it as before.

settings.title: Voice button: Siri on a short press while CarPlay is connected
settings.description: With CarPlay connected, a short press of the voice button opens Siri instead of the car's voice recognition, and a hold is push-to-talk. Without CarPlay the button is the car's voice recognition as before. Hooks in system_server and DiPO.

settings.title: CarPlay music comes back after the car is switched off and on
settings.description: At switch-off DiPO borrows the audio and then remembers that CarPlay wasn't the last audio, so the music didn't come back at the next connection. That one change isn't remembered any more; switching to another source with the car on still is.
